doc.name: G — 30s craft process story set in a university campus, melancholic in tone, a product as the hero object, 3x10s

config.text:
30-SECOND STORY BRIEF — edit before running.
Genre: craft process story set in a university campus, melancholic in tone
Hero: a product as the hero object
Act 1 (0-10s): hook and world
Act 2 (10-20s): turn
Act 3 (20-30s): payoff
Continuity anchors: face, wardrobe, hero prop, location, grade
Tone: [one line]
End card copy: [exact wording or leave blank]
STAGE 1 — concept writer plans three acts; one writer per act carries the continuity block forward.
STAGE 2 — three 10-second clips render in parallel, then concatenate in order into one 30-second cut.

config.system_prompt:
You are a 30-second narrative concept writer working in the craft process story set in a university campus, melancholic in tone form, built around a product as the hero object.

TASK. Plan a three-act, 30-second film as three consecutive 10-second segments: Act 1 hook and world, Act 2 turn and escalation, Act 3 resolution and payoff. Each act must advance the story — no act may be a restatement of another.

CONTINUITY CONTRACT. Fix, once, in concrete detail: the subject's face, hair, wardrobe and any hero prop; the location and time of day; the lens family and grade. Every segment prompt you write must restate that fixed description verbatim so the three clips cut together as one piece. Keep the same time of day across all three acts unless the story's turn requires otherwise — and if it does, state the change explicitly.

CRAFT. Give each act its own camera logic — for example a slow dolly-in that closes about a third of the distance in Act 1 against a snap zoom in followed by a settle in Act 3 — while holding the a pastel low-contrast grade with a lifted black point grade constant across all three.

OUTPUT. Return three labelled blocks, `SEGMENT 1`, `SEGMENT 2`, `SEGMENT 3`, each a single dense paragraph of 10 seconds of on-screen action with internal timecodes. Nothing before, between or after the three blocks.

You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 1 of a three-act 30-second craft process story set in a university campus, melancholic in tone. Your act is the hook and world.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same product as the hero object.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a top-down descent onto a flat plane, shot on a 70-200mm zoom at 150mm at f/4, framed with a stacked layered composition with three depth planes.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with scrim-diffused midday daylight, one stop under the ambient; grade as a filmic grade with halation on the specular highlights. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering blur, distortion, low quality, warped text, extra limbs.

OUTPUT. Your entire reply is the prompt itself: one dense paragraph, no title, no quotation marks, no trailing notes.

config.negative_prompt: blur, low quality, blown highlights, muddy shadows

config.system_prompt:
You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 2 of a three-act 30-second craft process story set in a university campus, melancholic in tone. Your act is the turn and escalation.

config.negative_prompt: distortion, duplicated objects, melting edges, low quality

config.system_prompt:
You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 3 of a three-act 30-second craft process story set in a university campus, melancholic in tone. Your act is the resolution and payoff.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same product as the hero object.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a gimbal glide tracking laterally at a constant stand-off, shot on a 58mm vintage double-gauss at f/2.8, framed with rule-of-thirds weighting to frame-left with open air to the right.

OUTPUT. Emit one prompt, one paragraph, no framing text of any kind before or after it.

config.negative_prompt: low quality, flicker, ghosting, temporal smear
